title: The Thirteenth Amendment abolished slavery in the United States
summary: The National Archives presents the amendment, ratified in 1865, as the constitutional abolition.
body: The U.S. National Archives presents the Thirteenth Amendment as the abolition of slavery in 1865. It is a United States constitutional change. It does not date the end of slavery everywhere else. Britain's Slavery Abolition Act 1833 is a different statute, for a different empire, and it had its own exceptions and compensation to slaveholders that this card does not inventory because that detail was not read from the UK act's sections.
